test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: Eight people M, N, P, S, T, V, X and Y are sitting in a straight row and all are facing north. M sits second from one of the extreme ends of the row. Only two people sit between M and N. P sits second to the right of N. As many people sit to the right of P as to the left of S. More than three people sit between S and T. V sits to the immediate right of X. Who sits third to the left of Y?
solution:
Eight people M, N, P, S, T, V, X and Y are sitting in a straight row and all are facing north.

1) M sits second from one of the extreme ends of the row.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c93a305fe3404f7583db04161825c0a59a9109665e5b3798baa13e0b482fdb52.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f7efa84dbedfa700317c4439e6fcc7be24d63f81ec6834949288c938976a560.png] 

2) Only two people sit between M and N.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aff9ab8f3266124def2bd659bd874e655c874d6164e068895787170b516ddd5.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/649540473206d48b9b3c9e67b3fe407b9ae0526af72d52f1bedf10a2dd501d35.png] 

3) P sits second to the right of N.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b9d9c7cdc689cd53c7d6463fea1e28befe0c2f2d0de002af4e4b7219151f08.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b9d9c7cdc689cd53c7d6463fea1e28befe0c2f2d0de002af4e4b7219151f08.png] 

4) As many people sit to the right of P as to the left of S.

Here case (i) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4875641bcb1e79205b4dc26f73653ecaf84ad2e7a80dde442163905ca91d36f.png] 

5) More than three people sit between S and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c5d7667562002d6fad58afdbcb6266b62a45eb099d14f4d6dd25e32d84e35a1.png] 

6) V sits to the immediate right of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e518293dce590a71e57e97495a70eb1f7e1b3652668315218bc8feaa996e0787.png] 

Thus seating arrangement of all eight people :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cc75727d9a26c06c104cd9614faf64508de8b4c83f0d8db76211ba6f5b14dc7.png] 

∴ Here, **'V' sits third to the left of 'Y'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"V".**
